title: Restriction atom from an assignment
statement: Given a coordinate assignment that marks each of the $n$ coordinates as free, fixed to $+1$, or fixed to $-1$, its restriction atom is the pair consisting of the set $J$ of coordinates marked free and the assignment of fixed signs to the coordinates outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate assignment on $n$ indices taking the values free, fixed to $+1$, or fixed to $-1$
caveat: The equivalence used to convert an assignment into a restriction atom is not defined in the snippet; the description reflects the stated restriction-atom type.
